rule_boxes.body: Adjacent short a (or a + ā) contract to one long ā. Pāṇini 6.1.101 akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ. Reverse: split ā into a + a when the words demand it.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 1 — a + a / a + ā → ā

rule_boxes.body: yaṇ sandhi: sadā + eva → sadaiva; brahma + eva → brahmaiva. Reverse: ai may hide a + e.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 2 — a + e → ai

rule_boxes.body: nṛtyati · gāyati · hṛṣyati — same ending, three roots. Discover before the paradigm.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 4 — 3sg present often ends -ti

rule_boxes.body: Prohibitive mā with imperatives: mā tyaja, mā gṛhāṇa. na negates statements.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 5 — mā + imperative = don’t

rule_boxes.body: Exactly two: anayor, vahnidāhikayor. Not plural -ānām / -eṣu.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 6 — dual gen/loc = -yor

rule_boxes.body: alaṃ governs the instrumental: alaṃ bhedānukathayā. Substitutes are labelled exercises.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 7 — alaṃ + instrumental = enough of

rule_boxes.body: Abstract -tva/-tā then ablative -āt builds causal “because”: virodhakatvāt.
rule_boxes.title: Rule box 8 — -tva + -āt = because of the fact that
